verdicts.evidence: The three training-stage scripts (cold-start SFT, reflection SFT, ATRL) exist with decomposed rewards, but the preprocessor raises NameError, ATRL uses placeholder data/model paths, KL config mismatches the paper, and only 4 of the claimed 64k records are released—so the pipeline cannot be run or its data sizes confirmed.
The trained Ophiuchus checkpoint, evaluation commands, benchmark inputs/splits, and baseline predictions are all absent; no benchmark was rerun.
No checkpoint or evaluation artifacts exist in the release; the in-domain GPT-5 comparison was not rerun or addressed by any executed experiment.
No trained checkpoint, benchmark data, or evaluation outputs are available, so comparisons against VILA-M3-40B and MMedAgent-7B could not be executed.

Focused tests confirm three tool handlers, multi-image state, format/answer/tool rewards, and a working zoom path (zoom + correct answer yields reward 4.0), but released SFT trajectories fail to parse, duplicate tool calls do not early-stop, and list-valued mask_path raises TypeError—so the framework is only partially functional with significant bugs.

overall: The logbook audits the official Ophiuchus repository and finds partial code infrastructure (tool handlers, training-stage scripts, reward computation) but no runnable training pipeline, no 64k corpus, no trained checkpoint, and no evaluation artifacts. All paper-level benchmark and training claims remain unverified; only the tool-loop design is partially supported by executed unit-level tests that also reveal parsing and runtime bugs.
